safe_content_feature_requests.title: First-run movement hint
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: The core distinction between walking and obstacle jumping is important to learn immediately.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Show a brief non-blocking hint on the first route.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route-specific collectible rumor
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Adds a reason to revisit routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: The trace has route identity but few explicit collection goals.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Feature a rotating collectible rumor tied to one route.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Temporary elite hunt challenge
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Creates a mastery target without permanent balance changes.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Combat rewards are readable but can benefit from a short-term goal.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Offer a bounded elite-focused Night Watch challenge.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Rotating marketplace discount
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: A temporary discount creates spending decisions while preserving baseline prices.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Discount cosmetics modestly for one AI world cycle.

observations.evidence: The trace starts immediately after route selection and relies on button labels to teach movement.
observations.recommendation: Add a one-session contextual hint explaining Walk versus Jump.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchases compete with route rewards, but there is no rotating value proposition.
observations.recommendation: Experiment with a small temporary marketplace discount rather than permanent price changes.

observations.evidence: Walking into an obstacle intentionally causes damage and does not advance, which is valid but should remain covered by tests.
observations.recommendation: Retain regression coverage for obstacle blocking, enemy blocking, and route completion.
